primary_source.citation: Takenori Kataoka and Takamichi Sano, On Euler systems for motives and Heegner points
claims_bound: Basic rank r_T is representation/base-field defined.
For T the p-adic Tate module of an elliptic curve over Q with K=Q, r_T=1 and Kato's Euler system is rank one.
For E over an imaginary quadratic K satisfying the Heegner hypothesis, r_T=2 and Heegner points have a natural rank-two Euler-system interpretation.
Theorem 1.5 constructs a rank-two Euler system with the stated K_infinity component only assuming the Heegner point main conjecture; the construction is non-canonical.
The explicit derivative setup assumes E(K)[p]=0, rank E(Q)>=1, rank E^K(Q)>=1, and finite p-primary Sha(E/K).
Conjecture 1.6 is the complex leading-term formula involving L*_S(E/K,1), period and Neron-Tate regulator.
Theorem 1.7 derives an algebraic variant under the Heegner point main conjecture up to a p-adic unit.
Theorem 1.8 obtains the p-part BSD formula only assuming the Heegner point main conjecture, Conjecture 1.6, and nonzero Bockstein regulator.

not treated as a complex L''(E,1) to Mordell-Weil-rank-two theorem

control_sources.accepted_scope: Kolyvagin-system refinement and main-conjecture-localized nontriviality for Selmer structure
control_sources.rejected_use: not treated as a classical complex second-derivative Gross-Zagier formula

negative_history_preserved: R7 generalized-Kato route re-entered transverse localization/Selmer-dimension input.
R8 open PR suggested BKS target-index mismatch but had failed CI and a source-trail defect; it was treated as search guidance only and not scientific authority.
R6 plectic route entry restrictions and earlier scalar theta-order saturation were not repeated.

derived_scope_result.statement: Representation-theoretic higher-rank Euler systems avoid the exact R8 target-index circularity only by changing the carrier/base field: over Q the elliptic-curve Tate module still has basic rank one; the rank-two Heegner realization over K is conditional and its derivative/leading-term route imports positive algebraic-rank, Sha/main-conjecture and regulator premises. It therefore does not provide an analytic-rank-two bootstrap for BSD over Q.
not_claimed: No impossibility theorem for all higher-rank Euler-system approaches.
No claim that the local Kataoka-Sano theorems are false or circular.
